chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from al-Qasim ibn Yahya, from his grandfather al-Hasan ibn Rashid, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

The Commander of the Faithful (peace be upon him) said: 'Get married, for the Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his family) said: Whoever loves to follow my Sunnah, then marriage is from my Sunnah.'

key_terms.أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: Amir al-Mu'minin - Commander of the Faithful, the title of Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (peace be upon him)
key_terms.التَّزْوِيجَ: al-tazwij - marriage, the institution of matrimony; here explicitly declared part of prophetic Sunnah
key_terms.سُنَّتِي: Sunnah - the established practice and way of the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family), which serves as a normative guide for believers

ai.seo_question: Is marriage (nikah) part of the Sunnah of the Prophet Muhammad?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq narrates from Imam Ali, who quotes the Prophet's command to marry, framing marriage as an integral part of the prophetic Sunnah. This hadith appears in the chapter on the abhorrence of bachelorhood, addressing early Muslim communities where celibacy was sometimes practiced in imitation of ascetic traditions. By linking marriage directly to the Prophet's own practice and command, the teaching elevates it from a merely legal matter to a religious duty rooted in prophetic example.

en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Al Qasim Bin Yahya, from his grandfather Al Hassan Bin Rashid, from Muhammad Bin Muslim, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Get married, for Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘The one who loves to follow my<sup>saww</sup> Sunnah, so the marriage is from my<sup>saww</sup> Sunnah’.
en.sarwar: 5. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from al-Qasim ibn Yahya from his grandfather, al-Hassan ibn Rashid from Muhammad ibn Muslim who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that ’Amir al-Mu’minin, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘You must become married because the Messenger of Allah, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause, has said, “Whoever wants to follow my Sunnah, must take notice that of my Sunnah is marriage.’””
